title: Cap. V Obj. 3: as one exists receiving eternal life, so considered — only the faithful predestinated
pass_a_gloss: Objection 3. Of what sort existing one receives eternal life, of such sort considered by God he has been predestinated that he might receive it: But only the faithful receives, and no other: Therefore only the faithful, and that as he is considered faithful, has been predestinated to receive eternal life.
pass_b_english: Obj. 3. As one exists when receiving eternal life, so considered by God he was predestinated to receive it. But only the faithful receives, and no one else. Therefore only the faithful — and as considered faithful — was predestinated to receive eternal life.
source_text: Obj. 3. Qualis existens accipit vitam aeternam, talis a Deo consideratus praedestinatus est ut acciperet: Sed solus fidelis accipit, et nemo alius: Ergo solus fidelis, idque ut consideratur fidelis, praedestinatus est ad accipiendam vitam aeternam.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. V Obj. 3 section 410. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap5_obj3_densify. Honest partial.
